description: Extend PitchSource enum to include RIAC, Foundry, Board, RIAC student sources

POST /api/pitches with source='foundry' and verify it returns in response
POST /api/pitches with source='board' and verify it returns in response
POST /api/pitches with source='riac_student' and verify it returns in response
